effect.name: Subtraction With Sinus (Background)
effect.description: Base and blend colors are subtracted after which the colors are reduced by the sinus function.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Subtraction With Sinus (Background) Shader | 2026.08.22 */
parameter.description: Base and blend colors are subtracted after which the colors are reduced by the sinus function.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable manages which color will be the subtracted. When this value is set to 0 then blend will subtract base and when set to 1 then base will subtract blend.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Background Multiplication
parameter.description: This variable defines the background multiplication factor. In previous versions of FSP shaders, it was _Mixing, but this has now been fixed.
